## Change type

- [ ] Add a new knowledge gap
- [ ] Claim a gap and add a note
- [ ] Add or update claims
- [ ] Supersede an existing claim
- [ ] Record or resolve a conflict
- [ ] Merge or redirect a duplicate
- [ ] Documentation or tooling only

## Summary

Describe what changed and why. Use Simple English for repository content.

## Governance checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] I searched existing notes, claims, gaps, and conflicts for duplicates.
- [ ] Every factual claim has a stable claim ID and evidence record.
- [ ] Existing claims were not silently deleted or rewritten.
- [ ] Any disagreement is recorded in `conflicts/registry.yaml`.
- [ ] Any relevant gap is linked to resulting notes and claims.
- [ ] `index.md` and `log.md` are updated when required.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_knowledge.py`.
- [ ] I did not add secrets or private infrastructure details.

## Review notes

Explain any unresolved conflict, uncertain evidence, or follow-up work.
